binding_note: tests/test_ops_readiness.py asserts that the key set here is exactly ALERT_CONDITIONS's key set. A condition cannot exist in code without a written response, and a response cannot be written for a condition that does not exist. observability.alert() already refuses an unknown condition at runtime; this closes the other direction.

verification.definitions: VERIFIED-LOCAL - the definitions are read and bound to the code by tests/test_ops_readiness.py, which runs everywhere.
verification.firing: UNVERIFIED - no alert has ever been delivered to a sink. ALERT_CONDITIONS's own comment says 'Wired to the sink in Phase 1'. observability.alert() writes a log record with an `alert` field and nothing consumes it. Every `notification` below describes the intended route, not an observed one.

LEDGER_DIVERGENCE.summary: A materialised control cell disagrees with the derived ledger.
LEDGER_DIVERGENCE.why_it_matters: budget_ledger_cell carries six derived money columns. If a materialised value drifts from the ledger it is derived from, availability is wrong, and a purchase request is checked against a number that does not exist. This is AUD-C-001's failure mode.
LEDGER_DIVERGENCE.detection: Scheduled recomputation of each cell's derived columns from the underlying ledger rows, compared to the stored value.
LEDGER_DIVERGENCE.threshold: ANY non-zero difference, in paise. There is no tolerance: a one-paisa divergence is a defect in the derivation, not noise.
first_response: Do NOT repair the cell. The stored value is the evidence of what the system believed when it authorised spend.
Record the diverging cell ids, both values, and the difference in paise.
Freeze budget approval for the affected WBS subtree.
Establish which side is wrong by recomputing from audit history, not from the cell.
LEDGER_DIVERGENCE.escalate_if: more than one cell diverges, or the difference moves between runs

AUDIT_CHAIN_BROKEN.summary: verify_chain reported intact=False for a stream.
AUDIT_CHAIN_BROKEN.why_it_matters: The hash chain is the control that makes history non-repudiable. A break means either a genuine edit or a defect in how entries are written. Both are P1, and they are not distinguishable from the alert alone.
AUDIT_CHAIN_BROKEN.detection: Scheduled run of app.backend.pg.audit.verify_chain over every stream_key, plus the same call at the end of any migration.
AUDIT_CHAIN_BROKEN.threshold: any stream with intact=False, OR stream_found=False for a stream that is expected to exist
first_response: Do NOT recompute any hash. Recomputation makes a tampered chain verify and destroys the only evidence there is.
Capture first_break_seq, head_seq and sequence_contiguous from the result, and the rows either side of the break.
Take a backup BEFORE any further writes to the stream.
A break at seq 1 with entry_hash IS NULL rows in the stream is the pre-002 legacy shape, not tampering - see docs/runbooks/poc-to-postgres-migration.md.
sequence_contiguous=false with no hash mismatch means entries were DELETED, not edited.
AUDIT_CHAIN_BROKEN.escalate_if: the break is in a stream carrying approval or capitalisation decisions

CIRCUIT_OPEN.why_it_matters: Outbound emission stops while the circuit is open. Commitments raised in the Hub do not reach the ERP, so the two systems diverge silently until it closes.
CIRCUIT_OPEN.detection: circuit state transition to open, per connection_id
CIRCUIT_OPEN.notification: ticket; page if open longer than 30 minutes
first_response: Read the connection's recent failures: an expired refresh token and a Zoho outage need different responses.
Do NOT force the circuit closed to 'unblock' a queue. The queue is durable; a forced close against a failing tenant burns the daily quota.
Check DLQ depth at the same time - an open circuit usually precedes a DLQ_DEPTH alert.
CIRCUIT_OPEN.escalate_if: more than one connection opens within an hour, or a circuit reopens immediately after closing

DLQ_DEPTH.summary: The dead-letter queue is above threshold.
DLQ_DEPTH.why_it_matters: Every dead-lettered message is a business event that has not reached its destination. Depth is a proxy for how far the two systems have diverged.
DLQ_DEPTH.threshold: warn at 25, page at 100, or any single item older than 24 hours
DLQ_DEPTH.notification: ticket at warn; page at the page threshold
first_response: Group by failure reason before retrying anything. A uniform reason is one fix; a scattered one is a systemic problem.
Retrying is idempotent by dedupe key, so a retry cannot double-count a commitment - but confirm the key is present before bulk-retrying.
Discard only with a recorded reason. A discarded item is a business event deliberately abandoned.
DLQ_DEPTH.escalate_if: depth grows while retries are running

DAILY_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED.summary: The Zoho daily API ceiling has been reached.
DAILY_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED.why_it_matters: No further calls succeed until the quota window resets. Every sweep and every outbound emission stalls, and the backlog lands at once when it resets.
DAILY_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED.detection: rate-budget counter reaching the configured daily ceiling
DAILY_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED.threshold: page at 100% of the ceiling; warn at 85%
DAILY_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED.notification: ticket at warn; page at exhaustion
first_response: Identify the consumer: an unbounded sweep and a legitimate volume day look identical in the counter.
Do NOT raise the ceiling as a first response. If a defect is spending the quota, a larger ceiling spends more.
Confirm the reset time and warn finance if a period close depends on a sync landing today.
DAILY_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED.escalate_if: the ceiling is reached on consecutive days

JOB_RESUME_LIMIT.why_it_matters: A job that keeps resuming is not making progress. The framework pauses it rather than looping forever, so the work it was doing is now not being done at all.
JOB_RESUME_LIMIT.detection: app.backend.integration.jobs raises this when claimed.resume_count >= max_resume_count
first_response: Read the job's checkpoint. A cursor that has not advanced across resumes means the chunk itself fails, not the deadline.
Do NOT raise max_resume_count to clear the alert - that converts a stuck job into a silently stuck job.
Check whether the job's soft deadline is being hit legitimately because the chunk grew.
JOB_RESUME_LIMIT.escalate_if: the same job kind breaches for more than one tenant
